summaries.label: Traditional CPU AprilTag
summaries.notes: Traditional full-frame AprilTag detector; tag hit in this dark scene.

summaries.label: Default MLTag (CScore capture + QNN)
summaries.notes: Default confidence 0.50; QNN loaded, but YOLO proposed no ROI during this baseline sample.

summaries.label: GStreamer MLTag baseline (JNI capture + QNN)
summaries.notes: Default confidence 0.50; no ROI during this baseline sample, so ROI decode cost is excluded.

summaries.label: MLTag active YOLO (CScore capture + QNN)
summaries.notes: Tuned confidence 0.05; ROI decode active. Final tag hit rate varied with the dark scene.

summaries.label: GStreamer active YOLO, downstream leaky queue
summaries.notes: Tuned confidence 0.05 with ROI decode active and a one-buffer leaky queue immediately before appsink. Queue growth was reduced but reached about 225 ms after 30 seconds.
